subject: Re: Lead Developer Position - Salary Expectations
TechSolutions Annual Review and Salary Update
Re: Lead Developer Position - Salary Expectations
body:
Hello John,

Thank you for your continued interest in the Lead Developer position at InnovateX. We were impressed with your skills and experience. As part of our hiring process, we would like to understand your salary expectations for this role. Please provide us with a figure that you believe reflects your value to the team, considering your extensive experience and the responsibilities this role entails.

We look forward to your response.

Best regards,

Alex Rivera
Talent Acquisition Specialist
InnovateX
